name: Sudden Zombie Horde
description: A massive sudden zombie horde has swarmed into the sector. Connecting roads become severely perilous (+4 Risk).

name: Highway Overpass Collapse
description: Rubble and twisted rebar block the arterial corridor. Navigating through requires slow, high-exposure climbing with intense danger.

name: Roof Stalker Ambush
description: A feral mutated stalker leaps from a fire escape directly onto the party rear guard before fleeing into the shadows.

name: Military Crate Airdrop
description: An automated supply drone crashed near a supply outpost, deploying sealed crates with food, water, and ammunition.

name: Nightfall & Thick Smog
description: Darkness and chemical fog envelope the ruins. Reduced line of sight increases ambient threat across every road in the city.

name: Encrypted Radio Intercept
description: Mira intercepts a garbled broadcast from Beacon Relay 3 reporting low hostile activity along the perimeter routes.
